User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /data/

# Search-discovery crawlers for AI answer engines: allowed, so the archive
# can be retrieved and cited. User-triggered fetchers (ChatGPT-User,
# Claude-User, Perplexity-User) follow their vendors' own rules.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

# Model-training crawlers: opted out. This is a training decision only; the
# search-discovery crawlers above are what put the archive into AI answers.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

# Content-Signal is a non-Google signal addressed to AI crawlers. It is not
# part of Google's robots.txt standard and has no effect on Google Search;
# Googlebot follows only the User-agent / Allow / Disallow rules above.
Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no

Sitemap: https://www.philosophydef.com/sitemap-index.xml
